name: shinchantw_cbt_week4_activity_package_weighted_20260803_155700_640948
sql:
/*
前五日活动：按活动开放日的 DAU 加权日均参与率 + 活动礼包收入。
加权日均参与率 = SUM(每日去重参与人数) / SUM(每日 DAU)，而非直接平均每日百分比。
仅使用已验证映射：游乐园参与门票 430001、繁体专属伙伴 430006、SG 福引机 10244；
礼包：游乐园 119201~119206，繁体专属伙伴 119701~119706，SG 福引机 110101/110102/110105/110106。
*/
WITH Config AS (SELECT DATE '2026-07-29' tc_start,DATE '2026-08-02' tc_end,DATE '2026-05-08' sg_start),
TCB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SGB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SGC AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_country' AND tag_value='新加坡'),
SGA AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'),
M AS (SELECT '新加坡全体(iOS+Android)' grp,c.u FROM SGC c UNION ALL SELECT '新加坡Android',c.u FROM SGC c JOIN SGA a ON c.u=a.u),
DAU AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."$part_date" d,COUNT(DISTINCT e."#account_id") dau FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Config c LEFT JOIN TCB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event"='login' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.tc_start AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.tc_end AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111') GROUP BY 1,2
 UNION ALL SELECT m.grp,e."$part_date",COUNT(DISTINCT e."#account_id") FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Config c JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SGB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event"='login' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.sg_start AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',c.tc_start,c.tc_end),c.sg_start) AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2),
ActDaily AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."$part_date" d,a.activity,COUNT(DISTINCT e."#account_id") users,COUNT(*) times
 FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Config c
 CROSS JOIN (VALUES (430001,'游乐园'),(430006,'专属伙伴'),(10244,'开心福引机')) AS a(item_id,activity)
 LEFT JOIN TCB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u
 WHERE e."$part_event"='item_change'
   AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.tc_start AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.tc_end AS VARCHAR)
   AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111')
   AND ANY_MATCH(e.a_rst,x -> TRY_CAST(x.id AS BIGINT)=a.item_id AND TRY_CAST(x.before AS DOUBLE)>TRY_CAST(x.after AS DOUBLE))
 GROUP BY 1,2,3
 UNION ALL
 SELECT m.grp,e."$part_date",a.activity,COUNT(DISTINCT e."#account_id"),COUNT(*)
 FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Config c
 CROSS JOIN (VALUES (430001,'游乐园'),(10244,'开心福引机')) AS a(item_id,activity)
 JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SGB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u
 WHERE e."$part_event"='item_change'
   AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.sg_start AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',c.tc_start,c.tc_end),c.sg_start) AS VARCHAR)
   AND b.u IS NULL
   AND ANY_MATCH(e.a_rst,x -> TRY_CAST(x.id AS BIGINT)=a.item_id AND TRY_CAST(x.before AS DOUBLE)>TRY_CAST(x.after AS DOUBLE))
 GROUP BY 1,2,3),
Pay AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,CASE WHEN CAST(e.product_id AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 119201 AND 119206 THEN '游乐园礼包' WHEN CAST(e.product_id AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 119701 AND 119706 THEN '专属伙伴礼包' WHEN CAST(e.product_id AS BIGINT) IN (110101,110102,110105,110106) THEN '开心福引机礼包' END activity,CAST(e.product_id AS VARCHAR) sku,COUNT(DISTINCT e."#account_id") buyers,SUM(TRY_CAST(e.pay_amount AS DOUBLE)/COALESCE(x.exchange,1)) revenue FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Config c LEFT JOIN TCB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange x ON e."$part_date"=x.ex_date AND e.pay_currency=x.currency WHERE e."$part_event"='charge' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.tc_start AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.tc_end AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox=FALSE) AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy=FALSE) AND (CAST(e.product_id AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 119201 AND 119206 OR CAST(e.product_id AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 119701 AND 119706 OR CAST(e.product_id AS BIGINT) IN (110101,110102,110105,110106)) GROUP BY 1,2,3
 UNION ALL SELECT m.grp,CASE WHEN CAST(e.product_id AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 119201 AND 119206 THEN '游乐园礼包' WHEN CAST(e.product_id AS BIGINT) IN (110101,110102,110105,110106) THEN '开心福引机礼包' END,CAST(e.product_id AS VARCHAR),COUNT(DISTINCT e."#account_id"),SUM(TRY_CAST(e.pay_amount_usd AS DOUBLE)) FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Config c JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SGB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event"='charge' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.sg_start AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',c.tc_start,c.tc_end),c.sg_start) AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox=FALSE) AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy=FALSE) AND (CAST(e.product_id AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 119201 AND 119206 OR CAST(e.product_id AS BIGINT) IN (110101,110102,110105,110106)) GROUP BY 1,2,3)
,
ActDailyScoped AS (
 SELECT a.*
 FROM ActDaily a
 WHERE a.activity<>'开心福引机'
    OR a.d=(SELECT MIN(x.d) FROM ActDaily x WHERE x.grp=a.grp AND x.activity='开心福引机')
)
SELECT 'activity_weighted' "数据模块",a.grp "对比组",a.activity "活动",NULL "礼包SKU",SUM(a.users) "累计日参与人次",SUM(a.times) "触发次数",SUM(d.dau) "活动日DAU人次",ROUND(100.0*SUM(a.users)/NULLIF(SUM(d.dau),0),2) "DAU加权日均参与率(%)",NULL "礼包购买人数",NULL "礼包收入USD" FROM ActDailyScoped a JOIN DAU d ON a.grp=d.grp AND a.d=d.d GROUP BY 1,2,3
UNION ALL SELECT 'activity_package',grp,activity,sku,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,buyers,ROUND(revenue,2) FROM Pay
ORDER BY 1,2,3,10 DESC;
